# KovaGPT

> KovaGPT is an AI workspace for conversational drafting, coding help, web-assisted answers, research, and image generation.

Free uses Lite; its Thinking control is an Upgrade to Plus action, not an executable Free mode. Plus Chat includes Lite, Medium, and Thinking. Chat effort choices use the same underlying Chat model and vary the bounded working effort. Pro Chat includes Lite, Medium, High, Extra High, Max, and Ultra; Ultra adds bounded sub-agent orchestration over the same underlying Chat model. Older Kova model names may still appear in existing conversations. Voice input is not currently part of the supported web product. Search, research, connected apps, and image generation depend on configured providers and account access. Scheduled background work and image editing are not currently available.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Chat with KovaGPT, choose an available response mode, and attach supported files.
- [Images](/images): Generate images when an image provider is configured.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Compare Free, Plus, and Pro plans.
- [Apps](/apps): Review the connections currently available to your account.
